the PTS is an attractive target, but the development of potent inhibitors of this transporter is not an easy task, as the PTS has a very high capacity for polyamine transport and the compounds must be designed to avoid the intrinsic toxicity of the polyamine moiety.

the PTS is an attractive target to deliver drugs to cancer cells, but that the design of such drugs requires a careful optimization of their chemical structure to avoid their cytotoxicity.
